name: pairing-code
title: Pairing Code
description: PairingCode and PairingCodeInput for pairing a device by code (OAuth device authorization, RFC 8628). PairingCode shows a short user code big, monospaced and grouped (BCDF-GHJK), spelled out character by character for screen readers, with a copy button, and can compare it with the code on the other screen: `confirm` asks whether they match, `enter` checks a typed code group by group. PairingCodeInput is the verification page's field: it normalizes case, drops characters outside `alphabet`, inserts the separator as the person types or pastes, and calls `onComplete` once the code is full. `agentHidden` keeps the code from agents.
docs:
`<PairingCode code="BCDF-GHJK" label="Pairing code" />` on the screen that shows the code; `<PairingCodeInput label="Code shown on your device" length={8} alphabet="BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXZ" onComplete={(code) => verify(code)} pending={looking} error={notFound ? "No device is waiting for that code." : undefined} />` on the verification page, which never knows the code.

**Display.** `code` takes the code with or without separators, in any case; `groupSize` (4) and `separator` ("-") shape it and what Copy writes. The groups are `aria-hidden` and a screen reader reads `labels.spell(groups)` instead ("B C D F, G H J K"). `size="lg"` takes `text-display` over `text-display-sm`. Copy announces `labels.copiedAnnouncement` and calls `onCopy(code)`.

**Comparison.** `compare="confirm"` with `text={{ prompt, matches, mismatch }}` shows the two answers and calls `onConfirm(matches)`. `compare="enter"` with `text={{ label, description, matches, mismatch }}` adds a field: each group of the shown code turns match (success, a tick), mismatch (destructive, a cross) or pending (neutral, a dashed circle) as the person types, a status line says whether they match, and `onMatchChange(matches)` runs when that flips.

**Input.** `PairingCodeInput` is UI SDK's Input in a Field: upper case, separators the person types are dropped and the component inserts its own at group boundaries, with the caret kept after the same characters; deleting next to a separator removes the character beside it. A character outside `alphabet` is never inserted. A pasted code fills it with or without separators. `onChange(code)` gets the normalized code on each edit; `onComplete(code)` runs each time an edit makes it full. `pending` makes it read-only with `aria-busy`; `error` shows in a live destructive Alert that describes the field, which turns `aria-invalid`. It sets `autoComplete="off"`, `spellCheck={false}`, `autoCapitalize="characters"` and `inputMode="text"`; `value`/`defaultValue` take a code.

**Agents.** The code group is a `pairing-code` component with `code` in its state and `copy()` and `confirm(true | false)` actions; an agent types into PairingCodeInput with `setValue`, normalized like typing. `agentHidden` puts the value, the copy button and the comparison under `data-agent-hidden` and leaves `code` out of the state, so agents can't read, copy, compare or type the code, and `copy` and `confirm` fail the step with why; a person still copies. Every visible word of the comparison comes from `text`; `labels` holds the accessible names, in English by default.
